statements.note: Public signatures are unchanged and only the pann branch changes. But for model_name='pann' the return shape of get_embeddings changes from flat (N*2048,) (np.concatenate of 1D arrays on axis 0) to (N, 2048), and the resulting mean/covariance, and hence FAD values, change by design. Whether that counts as breaking depends on interpretation (it is the stated bug fix), so no concrete check settles it.
